quote: Even on console, it's an absolute powerhouse 10/10! The last shooter to truly change the genre. A milestone in video game history. Still the best story ever told in a video game! The only area where Half-Life has the edge is gameplay.

author: MasterMP
quote: I never really liked the original because of its controls and camera system. For me, Twilight Princess had always been the best Zelda game. But this remake has completely changed my mind. It's the perfect example of how a remake can create an entirely new and much better gameplay experience. This is how you remake a classic: not just by improving the graphics, but by transforming the entire feel of the game. 10/10
